title: Record on every start path + close by feature (library side)
action: DEFECT (main-diagnosed, 5 live incidents 2026-07-28): sessions kept reverting mid-run to a previously closed feature. Chain: a stopping subagent fires the state-sync hook, which rebuilds the projection; the idle-bootstrap branch picks the newest ACTIVE workflow record; and closed features stayed active forever. fx-1 added a close-on-start transition and mv-4 fixed createWorkflow's default symmetry, but two holes remain, both proven by inspection of .bee/runtime/workflows/ on 2026-07-28: (a) several features that ran today have NO workflow record at all (main-verifies, foundation-fixes, parallel-default, test-batching-finish, ship-visibility-config) — so some start paths skip record creation entirely; (b) fx-1's close only reaches records that exist, so a feature with no record can never be closed, and starting status-diet left skill-token-diet active. FIX in packages/bee/lib (library only — the CLI surface is a sibling cell, do not touch bee.mjs or command-registry.mjs): (1) audit EVERY path that starts or adopts a feature in packages/bee/lib/state.mjs (default start, --as-lane start, any adopt/resume/handoff path) and guarantee each creates its workflow record — one helper, called from every path, never duplicated logic. (2) Close by FEATURE, not by record presence: when a feature starts, every other live record closes; if the outgoing feature has no record, that is not a reason to skip — it is a reason the audit in (1) must prevent. (3) Export exactly these two names for the sibling CLI cell to call (INTERFACE CONTRACT — the names and shapes are frozen so the two cells run in parallel): `listWorkflowRecords(root)` returning an array of the full records (may simply wrap the existing listWorkflows), and `closeWorkflowsForFeature(root, { keepFeature })` closing every live record whose feature differs from keepFeature and returning the array of closed {id, feature}. Keep both idempotent and lock-safe (updateWorkflow discipline). R82: run NO test suites; cap --feature-verify-pending; MAIN verifies at close.

truths: Every feature-start path in lib creates a workflow record — name the paths you audited in the report.
Starting a feature closes every other live record, including when the outgoing feature had none.
listWorkflowRecords and closeWorkflowsForFeature are exported with exactly the contracted names and shapes; both idempotent.
No behavior change to gate resets, lane handling, or claim/reservation logic.
prohibitions: Do NOT touch packages/bee/bee.mjs or packages/bee/lib/command-registry.mjs (sibling cell holds them).
Do NOT change the projection's picker logic (fx-1/D2 already handles it).
Do NOT run any test suite (R82).

regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier: regen deferred to orchestrator at feature close (parallel-default D2)

trace.outcome: lib/state.mjs: added ensureWorkflowRecordForFeature (the ONE workflow-record creation seam, idempotent by feature) and routed startFeature's default+lane branches and seedLegacyWorkflows' C1 materialization through it; replaced fx-1's outgoing-feature close with close-by-feature (closeWorkflowsForFeature(root,{keepFeature}) closes every OTHER live record, default path only, lane path closes nothing and startLane is byte-untouched); exported the frozen interface contract listWorkflowRecords(root) + closeWorkflowsForFeature(root,{keepFeature}) from lib/state.mjs (they need controlRootFor, which the workflow-store leaf may not import). Path audit of every start/materialize/adopt site recorded as a header comment block. lib/workflow-store.mjs needed no change.
